existing_evidence: Previously completed 1.3M-cell inference and independent RNA reference retrieval remain separate; they were not rerun here.

groups.scope: Configured complete analysis workflows from shared QC-filtered matrices. Includes native topic modelling for multiome and real cisTarget motif enrichment. Excludes raw-read alignment, peak calling and motif database construction. Native pruning, enhancer-link and regulon algorithms differ. No presumption of biological equivalence or superiority.
